source_universe: 10 dominant outcrossing insect-pollinated pollen-success target plants
selection_rule: highest mean FG_Pla_sp_z among species with >=6 of 8 sites and >=5 functional-generality rows
prospective_use: future floral morphology or breeding-system negative-control candidate
variables_not_used_for_selection: corrected trait matching; pollen receipt; floral morphology response; breeding-system response
claim_boundary: High realized functional generality is not pollinator effectiveness or proof of ecological independence; Farfugium is locked prospectively only as a high-interaction-breadth control candidate.
